claims.sentence: We retrospectively analysed data from 123 patients with insomnia disorder and 123 age‐ and gender‐matched good sleeper controls who completed a simple subjective habitual sleep duration question (Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index), a sleep diary (5-14 days), 2 nights of polysomnography, and two corresponding morning subjective estimates of sleep duration.
